Leverage: a run of stake S at leverage L has a notional of S x L, of which S x (L - 1) is borrowed from the reserve; the borrowed amount climbs with the ladder. S is encrypted, so the reserve commits liquidity in clear with the public bound of a run: at the start it lends `MAX_PAYOUT` (what a 100 cUSDC stake can be paid at most) into the game as an encrypted transfer of a public amount, and the game sends back `stake + lent - payout` at the end. Each live run is thereby fully funded on its own: whatever lenders withdraw meanwhile, the payout of a live run is already in the game. shares; interest earned). At most every `SYNC_INTERVAL`.\n    function requestSync() external {\n        uint64 nowTs = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        if (syncRequestedAt != 0 && nowTs < syncRequestedAt + SYNC_TIMEOUT) FHE.add(confidentialTotalSupply(), FHE.asEuint64(0));\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(assets);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(supply);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(interest);\n userdoc.notice: The Sirocco Reserve: a confidential cUSDC lending pool that funds Siroclimb's leverage. Lenders deposit cUSDC and receive reserve shares, an ERC-7984 token (`rcUSDC`): every share balance is encrypted. A share is worth `syncedAssets / syncedShares` cUSDC: the reserve's assets grow with the borrow interest players pay and with the stakes they lose, and shrink with what they win, so lenders carry the game's PnL. Leverage: a run of stake S at leverage L has a notional of S x L, of which S x (L - 1) is borrowed from the reserve; the borrowed amount climbs with the ladder. S is encrypted, so the reserve commits liquidity in clear with the public bound of a run: at the start it lends `MAX_PAYOUT` (what a 100 cUSDC stake can be paid at most) into the game as an encrypted transfer of a public amount, and the game sends back `stake + lent - payout` at the end. Each live run is thereby fully funded on its own: whatever lenders withdraw meanwhile, the payout of a live run is already in the game. If the reserve cannot lend the full amount, the transfer moves 0 (ERC-7984) and the run is a plain refund, without leverage; the outcome stays encrypted. What is public, what is not:  - deposit and withdrawal amounts and every lender's shares: encrypted. Withdrawals are    all-or-nothing on ciphertexts (enough shares, enough free cUSDC), so a failed one moves 0;  - the reserve's total assets, total shares and total interest earned: encrypted between syncs,    revealed together at most every `SYNC_INTERVAL` by public decryption, checked on chain with    the KMS proof (`finalizeSync`). Share price, TVL and APY come from these synced aggregates;  - the liquidity committed to live runs (`lockedAssets`, the public bound per run): public.    Utilization is `lockedAssets / syncedAssets`.
